strings.拥有屏障吸收法术伤害，屏障存在时大幅提升生命上限与攻击速度: Has a Barrier that absorbs Arts damage; while the Barrier persists, this unit has significantly increased Max HP and ASPD.
strings.释放技能直接夺取最近的非敌方“留声机”: Can use a skill to automatically seize control of the nearest non-enemy controlled 'Gramophone'
strings.庞大的机械怪兽，由大祭司驾驶。能够破坏木桩，损毁时会弹射驾驶员并自爆。: A massive mechanical monstrosity, driven by the High Priest. Able to destroy Wooden Stumps, and will eject the driver and self-destruct when destroyed.
strings.远程攻击造成溅射伤害，近战攻击造成更高伤害: Ranged attacks deal Splash damage, Melee attacks deal more damage
strings.周期性破坏巨蕈或木桩地面，使其无法被部署: Periodically destroys Giant Mushrooms and Stumps, rendering them unable to be deployed upon
strings.生命值降至0后自爆，造成大范围<$ba.stun>晕眩</>并弹出驾驶员大祭司: When HP drops to 0, it will explode, <$ba.stun>Stunning</> units in a large area and ejecting its pilot, the High Priest
strings.不进行攻击，无法被阻挡，每秒受到真实伤害: Will not attack, cannot be blocked, and takes True damage every second
strings.当凋零骑士死亡时，攻击力、攻击速度、移动速度大幅提升: Gains greatly increased ATK, ASPD, and Movement Speed when a Withered Knight dies.
strings.攻击时使目标与周围四格的单位受到物理伤害: Attacks deal Physical damage to the target and adjacent allied units
strings.蓄力攻击，对目标与周围四格的单位造成高额物理伤害: Does charged attacks, dealing heavy Physical damage to the targets and any adjacent units
strings.当<凋零骑士>死亡时，攻击力、攻击速度、移动速度大幅提升: Gains greatly increased ATK, ASPD, and Movement Speed when <Withered Knight> dies
strings.当腐败骑士死亡时，攻击力、攻击速度、移动速度大幅提升: Gains greatly increased ATK, ASPD, and Movement Speed when a Corrupted Knight dies.
strings.对三名目标发射爆炸箭，短暂延迟后爆炸，对目标与周围四格的单位造成高额法术伤害: Fires explosive arrows at three targets which explode after a short delay, dealing high Arts damage to the target and surrounding four tiles
strings.当<腐败骑士>死亡时，攻击力、攻击速度、移动速度大幅提升: Gains greatly increased ATK, ASPD, and Movement Speed when <Corrupted Knight> dies
strings.狱警形态<@eb.key>法术抗性提升</>，攻击造成<@eb.key>法术伤害: While in Jailer form, has <@eb.key>increased RES</>, deals <@eb.key>Arts damage</>, and will not attack Imprisonment Devices; When in Killer form, has <@eb.key>increased DEF</> and deals <@eb.key>Physical damage</>; When entering Executioner Mode, <@eb.key>frees all enemies on the field</>.
strings.攻击造成远程法术伤害，不攻击禁锢装置: Attacks become ranged and deal Arts damage, and no longer attacks Imprisonment Devices
strings.生命值首次降至0时进入杀手形态: The first time HP drops to 0, enters Killer Form
strings.进入杀手形态时解放全场敌人: Frees all imprisoned enemies when entering Killer Form
strings.攻击造成近战物理伤害，能无视目标一定的防御力: Uses melee Physical attacks that ignore a certain amount of the target's DEF
strings.夕绘出的怪物。【纬地经天】：<@eb.key>使我方晦明变化</>。【破桎而出】: A monster painted by Dusk. 'Weft and Warp': <@eb.key>shift Hui and Ming of allies</>. 'Break the Chains': If the shield <@eb.key>is not yet broken</>, <@eb.danger>deal massive ranged damage</>.
strings.【纬地经天】对最近目标释放十字型法术，效果范围内晦明属性变化: [Weft and Warp] Deals Arts damage to targets in the surrounding cross area, changing Hui-Ming attributes within its range
strings.【破桎而出】屏障未被击破则造成巨额范围伤害: [Break the Chains] Deals massive damage in a large radius if the Barrier is not destroyed before it expires.
strings.生命值首次降至0后进入第二形态: The first time HP drops to 0, enters Second Form
strings.攻击力提升，普通攻击进行两次: Gains increased ATK and normal attacks hit twice
strings.额外对最远目标释放【纬地经天】: Additionally unleashes [Weft and Warp] on farthest target
strings.混入灾后伊比利亚的深海教会成员之一，真诚地用自己的理念篡改了律法，追求着个体的完: A member of the Church of the Deep who snuck into disaster-ravaged Iberia. He changed the law of the land through his sincere beliefs, in pursuit of the perfect form, yet he was unable to fathom the will of the ocean. Then again, who could?
strings.同时攻击防御最高的两个单位: Attacks two units with the highest DEF simultaneously
strings.【大潮】对所有我方单位造成法术和<$ba.dt.neural>神经损伤</>: [Great Tide] Deals Arts damage and <$ba.dt.neural>Nervous Impairment</> to all allied units
strings.【崩坍】对若干我方单位造成物理伤害: [Collapse] Deals Physical damage to multiple allied units
strings.【断裂生殖】召唤子代缠绕我方单位使其<$ba.stun>晕眩</>: [Fragmentation] Summons its offspring to entwine themselves around allied units and <$ba.stun>Stun</> them
strings.【物种爆发】战斗经过较长时间后扣除所有目标生命: [Species Outbreak] After a long time, reduces the shared team Life Point pool by 100
strings.卡西米尔骑士竞赛三届冠军，不会使用法术的莱塔尼亚残次品，天生的武者——黑骑士，会: Three-time champion of the Kazimierz Major, a defective Leithanian unable to use Arts, a natural-born warrior—The Black Knight. <@eb.key>Passes through blocking units and deals Physical damage to them</>
strings.攻击阻挡自身的目标无视其一定防御力: Attacks against the blocker ignore a certain amount of DEF
strings.【速杀】被阻挡时穿过目标并对沿途目标造成物理伤害: [Swift Slayer] When blocked, bypasses the target and deals Physical damage to units along her path
strings.【肆虐风雪】造成范围物理伤害: [Brutalizing Blizzard] Deals Physical damage to units in the surrounding area
strings.攻击无视更多防御力并变为二连击: Attacks ignore more of the target's DEF and strike twice
strings.【瞬息杀机】每损失25%生命，清空范围内我方单位技力并使目标无法攻击或治疗一段时: [Momentum Murder] Whenever 25% HP is lost, clears the SP of all allied units within range and restricts the targets from attacking or healing for some time
strings.狼之主，自荒野中诞生，却将目光投向人世。: Il Signore dei Lupi was born in the wilderness, but he has cast his gaze upon the world of men.
strings.受到伤害降低，不可被<$ba.stun>晕眩</>: Damage taken is reduced and cannot be <$ba.stun>Stunned</>
strings.【溶血骇惧】使三名我方单位被恐惧吞噬，不可主动撤退，攻速大幅降低，并逐渐加速失去: [Hemolytic Horror] Causes 3 friendly units to be consumed by fear, greatly reducing their ASPD, significantly accelerating their periodic HP loss, and causing them to be unable to be retreated manually; affected units will return to normal after 'Signore dei Lupi' loses a certain percentage of HP
strings.第一形态生命值降为0后，获得【远古威慑】，周围我方单位降低攻击速度，并缓慢回复生: After the first form reaches 0 HP, gains [Primal Deterrence], reducing the ASPD of nearby friendly units, and slowly gaining HP over time
strings.不再拥有减伤，且不再释放【溶血骇惧】: No longer has Damage Reduction, and longer casts [Hemolytic Horror]
strings.攻击变为远程二连击，且攻击力提升: Attacks become ranged and strike twice, and gains increased ATK
strings.每隔一段时间释放，【狂暴怒嗥】，使血债账款快速上升: Periodically releases a [Furious Howl], causing Blood Debt to increase rapidly
strings.曾经遭遇过的整合运动干部，使用令人印象深刻的炙热长刀进行攻击: A Reunion squad leader you've previously faced, who attacks with an impressive searing blade.
strings.【冲锋】锁定前方路径范围内的一名目标，一定时间内移动速度大幅提升: [Charge] Locks onto a target within range on the path ahead, and gains greatly increased Movement Speed for a period of time
strings.首次被击倒后重生，恢复一半生命值: Revives after being defeated for the first time, recovering half its HP
strings.神出鬼没，无法被阻挡，被攻击后<@eb.key>快速奔跑</>，击倒后获得<@e: Elusive and ephemeral, unable to be blocked. <@eb.key>Dashes rapidly</> upon being damaged, and drops <@eb.key>Treasure</> when defeated.
strings.受到攻击后移动速度大幅度提升: Gains significantly increased Movement Speed after being attacked
strings.鸭爵雇佣的乌萨斯保安，无法被眩晕，击倒后获得<@eb.key>宝物</>: An Ursus bodyguard hired by the Duck Lord, cannot be stunned. Drops <@eb.key>Treasure</> when defeated.
strings.防御很高的实验造物，可以投掷石头造成超长时间<@eb.key>晕眩</>: An experimental creation with extremely high DEF, able to lob rocks that inflict a lengthy <@eb.key>Stun</>.
Can throw a rock that inflicts a very long <$ba.stun>Stun</> (will not target a unit that is already <$ba.stun>Stunned</>)
strings.一个背着自制喷气背包的怪人，被阻挡后会<@eb.key>飞起来</>一段时间: A strange individual with a self-made jetpack. When blocked, will <@eb.key>take flight</> for a short period of time.
strings.被阻挡后会升空一段时间（有冷却时间），期间不会被阻挡: When blocked, this unit will take off for a period of time (this effect has a cooldown)
strings.一位被源石严重侵蚀的保安，<@eb.key>连续攻击</>时会提高攻击力和攻击速: A security guard who has been severely corrupted by Originium. <@eb.key>Consecutive attacks on the same target</> will increase their ATK and ASPD, but stacks will <@eb.key>reset</> after not attacking for 4 seconds.
strings.持续进行攻击时提高攻击力和攻击速度（有上限），停止攻击数秒后复原: Continuous attacks will increase ATK and ASPD, up to a limit. This effect will reset after a few seconds after this unit stops attacking
strings.大幅度削弱我方单位的作战能力，会周期性地为自己添加抵御伤害的<@eb.key>护: Significantly weakens the combat capabilities of our units and periodically gains a <@eb.key>Shield</> to absorb damage.
strings.使全战场我方所有单位攻击力、防御力减半，部署费用回复速度减半，再部署时间加倍: Halves the ATK and DEF of all your units on the battlefield; Halves natural DP regeneration rate; Doubles Redeployment Time
strings.周期性地添加正比于自身最大生命值的伤害防护<$ba.barrier>屏障</>: Periodically gains a Barrier proportional to Max HP.
strings.猩红剧团的忠实观众，攻击额外造成<@eb.key>神经损伤</>。: A diehard fan of the Crimson Troupe. Attacks inflict <@eb.key>Nervous Impairment</>.
strings.猩红剧团的演员，攻击额外造成<@eb.key>神经损伤</>，受到一定次数伤害后: A performer of the Crimson Troupe. Attacks inflict <@eb.key>Nervous Impairment</>; After receiving a certain number of hits, greatly increases ASPD of all enemies.
strings.受到一定次数伤害后，立刻使当前全场敌人在短时间内攻击速度大幅提升: After receiving a certain number of hits, greatly increases all enemies' ASPD for a short period
strings.剧团之灾卢西恩，代号傀影。会<@eb.key>穿过阻挡其的单位</>并留下<@e: Calamity of the Crimson Troupe, code name Phantom. <@eb.key>Passes through blocking units</> and leaves an <@eb.key>Ominous Apparition</> behind. Attacks and skills inflict <@eb.key>Nervous Impairment</>.
strings.未被阻挡时有几率闪避物理与法术攻击，被阻挡时可以快速移动至其身后并在原地留下一个: Has a chance to dodge Physical and Arts attacks when not blocked. When blocked, swiftly moves behind the target and leaves an <Ominous Apparition> at the original location
strings.会使用技能对周围造成物理伤害，攻击和技能无视目标一定防御力且额外造成<$ba.d: Can use skills to deal Physical damage to the surrounding area; attacks and skills ignore a certain amount of DEF and inflict <$ba.dt.neural>Nervous Impairment</>
strings.一片影子。从不曾离开，从不曾真实存在。: A patch of shadow. It has never once left, nor has it ever truly existed.
strings.未被阻挡时有几率闪避物理与法术攻击: Has a chance to dodge Physical and Arts attacks when not blocked
strings.会使用技能对周围造成物理伤害: Can use a skill to deal Physical damage in the surrounding area
strings.攻击和技能无视目标一定护甲且额外造成<$ba.dt.neural>神经损伤</>: Attacks and skills ignore a certain amount of armor and inflict additional <$ba.dt.neural>Nervous Impairment</>
strings.唯唯诺诺的佩洛，<@eb.key>隐匿</>，攻击使目标<@eb.key>眩晕<: Obedient Perro. <@eb.key>Invisible</>, attacks cause <@eb.key>Stun</>, drops <@eb.key>Treasure</> when defeated.
strings.对【国度】内的单位造成高额物理伤害；持续在自身中心一定范围生成【国度】: Deals heavy Physical damage to units on tiles affected by [Dominion]; continually generates [Dominion] in a certain radius around self
strings.对【国度】中的我方单位造成高额物理伤害: Deals heavy Physical damage to allied units on tiles affected by [Dominion]
strings.持续在自身周围8格生成【国度】，大幅降低其中我方单位的攻击速度: Continuously generates [Dominion] on the surrounding 8 tiles, significantly reducing the ASPD of allied units
strings.攻击会在3个目标间跳跃并附带寒冷，每次跳跃伤害降低；能攻击敌人并在敌人间跳跃，提: Attacks jump between 3 targets and inflict Cold, reducing damage with each jump; attacks can also target and jump between other enemies, increasing their Movement Speed and ASPD
strings.攻击施加<$ba.cold>寒冷</>，且会在3个目标间跳跃，每次跳跃伤害降低: Attacks inflict <$ba.cold>Cold</> and jump between 3 targets, with each jump dealing reduced damage
strings.【反自然馈赠】攻击其他敌人并在3个敌人间跳跃，提升它们的移动和攻击速度: [Unnatural Gift] Attacks can hit and jump between 3 other enemies, increasing their Movement Speed and ASPD
strings.数次攻击后<@eb.key>晕眩</>我方单位，由于藤蔓结构不稳定，很容易受到火: <@eb.key>Stuns</> allied units after several attacks. The rickety vine formation makes it susceptible to fire
strings.受到来自自然环境的伤害时，自身在短时间内获得高额<$ba.fragile>脆弱<: Gains a large <$ba.fragile>Fragile</> effect after taking damage from environmental effects
strings.鸭爵的合伙人和徒弟，伶牙俐齿的投机者。: Duck Lord's associate and apprentice, an opportunist with a slick tongue.
strings.始终面向我方干员数量较多的方向: Always faces the direction with the most Operators.
strings.受到来自正面的物理/法术伤害降低80%: Takes 80% less Physical/Arts damage from the front.
strings.被击倒时，朝伤害来源丢一团毒雾，造成法术持续伤害。\r\n: When defeated, hurls a cloud of toxic mist at the source of the damage, dealing Arts damage over time.
strings.被击倒后，向击倒自身的目标发射一团毒雾，持续对周围造成法术伤害: When defeated, fires a cloud of toxic mist at the unit that defeated it, continuously dealing Arts damage to the surrounding area
strings.被阻挡时会寄生在阻挡者上，造成法术持续伤害，并使目标收到的元素损伤增加；寄生目标: When blocked, parasitizes the blocker, dealing Arts damage over time and increasing the Elemental Injury the target takes; when the parasitized target's Elemental Injury bursts, it spreads to the four surrounding tiles.
strings.自身不容易受到攻击: Less likely to be targeted by attacks
strings.被阻挡时会对目标进行寄生，寄生目标持续受到法术伤害，且受到的<$ba.dt.el: When blocked, parasitizes its target; the parasitized target continuously takes Arts damage and takes increased <$ba.dt.element>Elemental Injury</>
strings.寄生目标<$ba.dt.element>元素损伤</>爆发时对周围四格其他我方单: When the parasitized target's <$ba.dt.element>Elemental Injury</> bursts, inflicts a large amount of the same type of <$ba.dt.element>Elemental Injury</> on the other allied units in the four surrounding tiles
strings.隐匿；隐匿状态下同时攻击3个目标。: Invisible; while Invisible, attacks 3 targets at once.
strings.<$ba.invisible>隐匿</>状态下同时攻击数个目标: While <$ba.invisible>Invisible</>, attacks several targets at once
strings.抓取至多三个非精英领袖飞行敌人，为自身补充弹药；全弹发射: Grabs up to three non-Elite, non-Leader aerial enemies to replenish its own ammo, then fires every round
strings.周期性束缚并吞噬数个非精英领袖飞行敌人，并回复等量弹药: Periodically binds and devours several non-Elite, non-Leader aerial enemies, restoring an equal amount of ammo
strings.一次性消耗所有弹药对目标造成大量物理伤害: Spends all of its ammo at once to deal heavy Physical damage to its target
strings.被击倒后变为傀儡并使周围其他敌人获得5层护盾；傀儡需要30次伤害击倒且不可被阻挡: When defeated, turns into a puppet and grants 5 stacks of Shield to the other enemies nearby; the puppet takes 30 hits to defeat, cannot be blocked, and revives after a set time.
strings.被击倒后进入再生状态并使周围一定距离内其他敌人获得可以抵挡物理及法术伤害的护盾，: When defeated, enters a regeneration state and grants the other enemies within a certain distance a Shield that blocks Physical and Arts damage; the Shield breaks after taking a certain number of attacks
strings.再生状态需要数次伤害击倒，一段时间后重生: In the regeneration state, it takes several hits to defeat; it is reborn after a while
strings.折射；拥有折射时自身生命值+100%: Refraction; while Refraction is active, its HP +100%
strings.<$ba.refraction>折射</>生效时自身生命值大幅提升: While <$ba.refraction>Refraction</> is active, its HP is greatly increased
strings.能够汇聚炎国众人力量的装置；周期性对敌人喷射火焰: A device that can gather the strength of the people of Yan; periodically sprays flames at enemies
strings.战斗开始时，“炎佑”获得等于当前场地所有炎盟约干员一定比例的攻击力与生命值: At the start of combat, 'Yan's Protection' gains ATK and HP equal to a certain percentage of those of all Yan alliance Operators currently on the field
strings.同时攻击数个目标，攻击附带攻击力一定比例的<$ba.dt.burning2>灼燃: Attacks several targets at once; its attacks inflict <$ba.dt.burning2>Burn Damage</> equal to a certain percentage of its ATK, and the enemy units around it take a certain percentage of <$ba.elementfragile>Elemental Fragility</>
strings.【祛恶之焰】对攻击范围内的一名敌人持续喷射火焰，每秒造成攻击力一定比例的法术伤害: [Evil-Banishing Flame] Continuously sprays flames at one enemy within attack range, dealing Arts damage equal to a certain percentage of its ATK every second, and also damaging a few other enemies around the target
strings.被源石严重侵蚀占据的蒸汽甲胄。\r\n展现源石发生作用最常见的形态——侵蚀。:
A steam suit of armor seized by severe Originium corrosion.
Shows the most common form of Originium at work: corrosion.
strings.随机选择目标发射射线造成法术伤害: Fires a beam at a randomly chosen target, dealing Arts damage
strings.【灭顶之灾】选择攻击力最高的干员对其发射一枚<刺胄之弹>，<刺胄之弹>到达目标位: [Woe of Extinction] Fires an <Armor Piercer> at the Operator with the highest ATK; when the <Armor Piercer> reaches the target position it explodes, <$ba.stun>Stunning</> the target and the units in the 8 surrounding tiles for a long time and dealing Physical damage to them every second; attacking the <Armor Piercer> several times while it is in flight will destroy it
strings.生命值低于一定比例时，受到的物理与法术伤害降低，【灭顶之灾】额外发射<刺胄之弹>: When HP falls below a certain percentage, takes reduced Physical and Arts damage, and [Woe of Extinction] fires an additional <Armor Piercer>
strings.【旧日的剑与锤】在模拟中达成特定条件并进入隐秘核心回合时，<假想敌：胄>将获得<: [Sword and Hammer of Olden Days] When specific conditions are met in the simulation and the Hidden Core round is entered, <OpFor: Armor> appears in its full form together with <'Armor Cleaver'> and <'Armor Crusher'>
strings.<“斩胄之剑”>和<“破胄之锤”>初始无敌；被击落时受到伤害以一定比例传递给<假: <'Armor Cleaver'> and <'Armor Crusher'> start out Invulnerable; once shot down, a certain percentage of the damage they take is passed on to <OpFor: Armor>
strings.<“斩胄之剑”>和<“破胄之锤”>周期性飞向场上攻击力最低的一名干员并自爆，使目: <'Armor Cleaver'> and <'Armor Crusher'> periodically fly to the Operator with the lowest ATK on the field and self-destruct, <$ba.stun>Stunning</> the target and the Operators in the 8 surrounding tiles and dealing Physical damage to them every second, then return to <OpFor: Armor>'s side; they lose Invulnerability in flight and are shot down after taking a certain number of hits; once shot down, they count as ground units and take increased damage
